styles.name: Minimal
styles.direction: Strip the composition to what is necessary. Let white space carry the hierarchy and keep decoration out of it.

styles.name: Bold Modern
styles.direction: Large type, high contrast and decisive blocks of colour. Nothing tentative.

styles.name: Editorial
styles.direction: Treat it like a printed magazine: a visible grid, real hierarchy and generous reading measures.

styles.name: Retro
styles.direction: Borrow from a specific decade rather than a generic past. Commit to its type, colour and printing quirks.

styles.name: Luxury
styles.direction: Restraint reads as expensive. Fine rules, wide letter-spacing, deep space and very few elements.

styles.name: Playful
styles.direction: Use movement, rounded forms and unexpected colour. Keep it charming, not chaotic.

styles.name: Brutalist
styles.direction: Expose the structure. Default typefaces, hard edges, visible grid, no ornament.

styles.name: Organic
styles.direction: Irregular shapes, natural colour and a hand-made quality. Avoid perfect geometry.

styles.name: Geometric
styles.direction: Build everything from a small set of shapes and angles used consistently.

styles.name: Gradient Tech
styles.direction: Depth through gradient and glow rather than illustration. Keep type crisp against it.

styles.name: Swiss / International
styles.direction: Flush-left ragged-right type on a strict grid. Information first, expression second.

styles.name: Maximal
styles.direction: Fill the frame deliberately. Layer type, pattern and image, but keep one clear reading path.

styles.name: Monochrome
styles.direction: One hue plus its tints and shades. Contrast comes from value, not colour.

styles.name: Vintage Print
styles.direction: Limited spot colours, visible registration and paper texture, as if screen printed.

styles.name: Corporate Clean
styles.direction: Predictable in the best sense: consistent spacing, clear hierarchy, no surprises.

styles.name: Illustrative
styles.direction: Let drawn elements carry the message and keep type in a supporting role.
